approval.user_instruction: go ahead and pass the creek plum, keep going
approval.scope: Prunus rivularis curation; no broader range-rule waiver

taxonomy.note: POWO explicitly lists var. pubescens as a heterotypic synonym. County evidence under that name is used at species rank. Do not automatically merge all Prunus murrayana records.

evidence.detail: Zhao et al. 2016 Table 1 lists P. rivularis, Wen 11988, Texas Kerr Co., GenBank KU525426; table notes voucher deposited at US.
William R. Carr, No Place but Texas (working draft, Nov 2009), lists Concho under P. rivularis var. pubescens, citing Enquist 1997, Phytologia 82(4):289–299.
Same Carr treatment explicitly lists Edwards County under var. pubescens.

range.limitations: Carr is an incomplete working draft; these county listings are literature evidence, not individually transcribed specimen records. Synonym mapping to current POWO is explicit.

bonap.use: Consulted as primary distribution reference; no unlabeled county polygon was used as the sole exact-county proof.

excluded_previous_evidence.reason: Outside user target counties; may inform morphology only.
Not needed for threshold. Purola occurrence is introduced; no wild-native inference from that record.
Prior BCP PDF URL returned 404 during review; not relied upon for threshold.

morphology_review.author: A. C. Gibson
confirmed: clonal thicket-forming shrub with spreading shallow roots
alternate simple leaves with toothed margins and glands
small white flower clusters on short shoots
morphology_review.correction: The UT local treatment describes shoots as not spinescent; do not teach universal thorniness. Leaf glands can shed as leaves develop, so absence on older leaves is not decisive.
morphology_review.comparison_note: Retain habit and flower arrangement comparison with P. mexicana and P. serotina. Do not reduce P. rivularis versus P. angustifolia to a range-only test.

handoff.visual_status: exact-species images still require existing-material routing and license verification
